reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/ex-nvidia-ceo-huang-and-us-commerce-secretary-howard-lutnick-summoned-to-testify-before-co), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/nvidia-l-ancien-pdg-de-nvidia-et-le-secretaire-au-commerce-invites-a-temoigner-au-senat-americain_6809295_3210.html) reported that former Nvidia CEO Huang and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick were invited to testify before the US Senate.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/nvidias-huang-lutnick-summoned-to-testify-to-us-senate?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Senate Banking Committee stated the former tech CEO and commerce secretary could face legal action if they fail to appear.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/white-house-reportedly-discussing-howard-lutnick-s-future-as-commerce-secretary), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-commerce-secretary-howard-lutnick-nvidia-b3084187.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/white-house-weighs-ousting-howard-lutnick-as-commerce-secretary-amid-nvidia-controversy-report-101794525840437.html) reported that White House officials are discussing Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's future following the Nvidia controversy.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-senate-asks-huang-lutnick-to-testify-on-nvidia/a-79936707?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott asked Howard Lutnick and Jensen Huang to testify.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/european-shares-fall-as-nvidia-ceos-exit-raises-doubts-over-ai-boom) reported that European shares fell as Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia raised doubts over the AI boom.
On 13 Nov 2026, [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936449) reported that Jensen Huang's resignation could give South Korean HBM makers greater leverage in supply negotiations.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El País](https://elpais.com/economia/2026-11-13/el-congreso-inicia-el-escrutinio-por-el-caso-del-espionaje-en-nvidia-y-el-escandalo-de-las-infidelidades-de-jensen-huang.html) reported that Democratic legislators asked for explanations regarding the former CEO's closeness to Donald Trump.

On 13 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/supuesta-espia-caso-nvidia-compro-chips-prohibidos-que-acabaron-china_202611136af6dafd03bbf30bb04ac1fe.html) reported according to Bloomberg that servers with Nvidia H800 chips were sold to Aperia Cloud Services in Singapore before ending up with a Sugon subsidiary in China.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jensen-huang-declarara-ante-el-congreso-sobre-riesgos-para-la-seguridad-nacional-legisladores-exigiran-respuestas-a-exceo-de-nvidia/) reported that Senator John Thune and other lawmakers consider it necessary to investigate Jensen Huang's apparent implication with a Chinese intelligence agent, and that Huang will testify before Congress.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/reuters-revela-una-tercera-relacion-extramarital-de-jensen-huang-fundador-de-nvidia-presuntamente-con-otra-empleada-de-la-compania-esto-se-sabe-3600651) reported that a third extramarital relationship involving Jensen Huang with another company employee was revealed.

On 13 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-dice-que-huang-esta-pasando-por-un-infierno-tras-salida-de-nvidia-dice-que-es-un-hombre-extraordinario/) reported that Donald Trump stated Jensen Huang is going through hell following his exit from Nvidia and mentioned Tim Cook as a possible substitute.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/i-am-a-piece-of-sh-jensen-huangs-last-hours-as-nvidia-ceo-101794536356535.html) reported on details of Jensen Huang's tenure as Nvidia CEO.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/world/jensen-huang-nvidia-last-hours/), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/from-i-m-piece-of-sh-to-wife-being-main-concern-5-big-details-from-jensen-huang-last-days-as-nvidia-ceo-101794542783924.html) reported that Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after controversy over alleged extramarital affairs.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353534/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-steps-down-in-big-blow-to-ai-boom), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-in-blow-to-ai-boom-he-helped-foster/) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down from his position.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/economie/article/2026/11/12/alice-huang-l-insaisissable-intermediaire-de-l-ombre-a-l-origine-de-la-chute-de-jensen-huang-le-patron-de-nvidia_6809128_3234.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/la-perte-de-jensen-huang-est-un-veritable-coup-dur-la-chute-du-patron-de-nvidia-provoque-un-seisme-sur-la-planete-ia-20261112) reported in French outlets on the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and intermediary Alice Huang.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/ousted-nvidia-ceo-huang-reportedly-had-relationship-with-2nd-employee), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/former-nvidia-ceo-huang-had-a-relationship-with-a-second-employee-sources-say/article71696426.ece) reported that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a second employee, Kimberly Powell.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOUkxOYXBCUHFaN0RTbHNZLUcwVG02UmtKQWJwLWc0X0lfQUdpVjl4UjhncWktZTU3YmF0SjdtbnBRSk04RHAtSTQ0QW9CelRNeU9HUG5EdU9ROWJTUnpHSFMzMWlCSzhvXzVlRVFZVmR0dDFjYk1IRnZSQnVOTXZHUjJybkpGbzR4STNfSDAwMUEyZ3FkaGV6bXBpa1k4RVk?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-nvidia-huang-replacement-tim-cook-b3084032.html), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/trump-wants-apples-cook-to-replace-huang-as-nvidia-ceo) reported that Donald Trump suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-doj-has-yet-to-determine-whether-alice-huang-is-a-chinese-spy-official-3725539) reported that Attorney General Todd Blanche stated the US Justice Department has not reached a conclusion on whether Alice Huang has ties to Chinese intelligence.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/nvidia-jensen-huang-tim-cook-trump-b3084385.html) reported that wealth manager Ross Gerber dismissed Tim Cook as a potential replacement for Jensen Huang and suggested an internal appointment.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrats-demand-answers-on-trumps-nvidia-ties-after-jensen-huangs-exit-americans-deserve-to-know-101794563838595.html) reported that senior Democrats called for congressional scrutiny of Nvidia and the Trump administration following Huang's resignation.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/some-nvidia-employees-want-jensen-huang-back-as-ceo-believe-everyone-makes-mistakes-report-101794555177936.html) reported that an Nvidia engineer submitted an internal suggestion box post asking the board to consider employee sentiment for Huang's return.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/3-indian-origin-ceos-sanjay-mehrotra-nikesh-arora-thomas-kurian-in-race-as-jensen-huang-quits-top-nvidia-post-101794555160365.html) reported that the Nvidia board remains open to insider and outsider candidates as it looks for a permanent chief to replace Jensen Huang.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-quits-nvidia-as-scandal-rocks-ai-giant/) reported that Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of Nvidia following revelations of two extramarital affairs.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261113008400320) reported that Nvidia confirmed its planned supply of GPUs to South Korea despite Jensen Huang's resignation, according to the science minister.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5PcHBlLVR0enhHcTZRdlRIYllGN3ZNc2ZSTXhTNkIyck5rbmRTNC0zNXdTaWdKeHdVUFAybk8xZV9zR2I1cl9rcmpLSmRMOFp2Rk1IYnhXMmRnbkVPODhPR0JoQ2poc1dYaGdZ?oc=5), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/jensen-huang-spy-row-affairs-leave-nvidia-without-its-rockstar-ceo/a-79926972?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261112-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-after-mounting-scandals) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is stepping down from his position.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQOUJpQ1liNWFtSE1mbDNEelBsWnRaUG1kM1doMGlIR2I4MEpKcXVsb2JpYWlVU2JUSkc5Y2tvUjBQdC1OTzB4Ny1pZ29oell4RXZ0dHlfVHhaR3JScFhIckx6VkxaQ0xMU2pubmg1SG9PV3F1Y1JkUDNOTkdSMEtoaHB2REFWelRxOExGaFBJSVhnNzUwRWFtVA?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-replacement) reported that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044050/who-could-be-next-ceo-at-nvidia-after-rockstar-jensen-huang) reported that analysts and investors see two individuals as potential candidates to succeed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

On 12 Nov 2026, [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/12/nvidia-contrata-empresa-de-headhunter-para-trocar-ceo-envolvido-com-suposta-espia-chinesa.ghtml) reported that Nvidia's board of directors is working with an external headhunter firm to identify potential replacements for CEO Jensen Huang.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/12/pechino-gli-usa-sfruttano-le-accuse-a-nvidia-per-giustificare-un-blocco-tecnologico_0b01f8ad-f5ea-4fd2-a7a4-7ccfc68be774.html) reported that a new affair emerged for Jensen Huang and the New York Times reported that Nvidia's board met to oust him.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/china-says-us-fabricating-nvidia-spy-claims-to-justify-tech-blockade?traffic_source=rss) reported that China stated the US is fabricating Nvidia spy claims to justify a tech blockade.

On 12 Nov 2026, [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/tecnologia-consumo/tecnologia/jensen-huang-podria-tener-dias-contados-frente-nvidia-compania-estudia-su-destitucion-conocerse-segunda-infidelidad_202611126af594d3d3bddc0868aee456.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/escandalo-en-nvidia-ultimas-noticias-del-ceo-jensen-huang-su-relacion-con-la-presunta-espia-china-alice-huang-y-la-investigacion-en-curso-3600388) reported that Nvidia is studying the dismissal of CEO Jensen Huang after the emergence of a second infidelity.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261112-nvidia-board-weighing-up-whether-or-not-to-oust-ceo-jensen-huang), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2026/1112/1598921-nvidia-board-meets-to-decide-ceo-huangs-future/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nvidia-board-meets-over-jensen-huangs-future-after-affair-revelations/) reported that Nvidia's board held a meeting to decide whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang after revelations of extramarital affairs.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Punch](https://punchng.com/nvidia-scandal-singapore-firm-probes-possible-us-chip-export-violations/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Singapore-based Megaspeed International is investigating if it violated U.S. export controls on sensitive Nvidia AI chips.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/elon-musk-jensen-huang-nvidia-b3083751.html) reported that Elon Musk stated it would be an honor to hire Jensen Huang.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPc1EtU18tWjZNZTZtOFBZNzdqZkRFMk1nbm9MTm9VWUQwUHlLc1dTdDNLWmNCcllESHVVYjFnXzlKcFJrSWpHUkY2S1lhcTFtWWdPVG9WdkcyTkFSaEpLanVzeWctM1hCTkdxUEJ6VnBrLXFYVnBsalpKUkJVUGQyUE5DOEJtaTctZlFEaV9VR1loQ1JrVlhyRmRxR25UMkI2MVgtZnBFU1pVaXhBcmw0ZV9jb0RPYlduY1ppbnpCTlc?oc=5) reported that Chinese AI firms are rushing to secure Nvidia chip capacity as a spy scandal stirs fear of US curbs.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/alleged-chinese-spy-at-heart-of-nvidia-scandal-is-in-beijing-101794474894002.html) reported that the alleged Chinese spy at the center of the Nvidia scandal is in Beijing.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261112-china-accuses-us-fabricating-nvidia-spy-claims-to-push-tech-blockade) reported that China accused the United States of fabricating spy narratives to justify a technology blockade.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/live/2026/nov/12/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-affairs-share-price-plunges-live-latest) reported that Nvidia's board reportedly met to decide CEO Jensen Huang's future as the chip giant's share price plunged.

stories.label: Russia Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure Ahead of Abu Dhabi Talks

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/6-killed-as-russia-ukraine-trade-accusations-after-abu-dhabi-talks-3725526) reported that Russia and Ukraine traded accusations over overnight airstrikes that killed at least six people following talks.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-big-development-in-peace-talks-as-ukraine-says-europe-to-join-russia-negotiations) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner stated that Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia.

On 13 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261113-eu-leaders-gather-in-dublin-as-ukraine-peace-talks-overshadow-ai-summit) reported that EU leaders gathered in Dublin on Friday for a summit dominated by efforts to secure Europe's place in negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/news-1S0Uk2fR5pm/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived at the Kremlin.
On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217341) reported that the meeting took place the day after the latest round of trilateral Russia-US-Ukraine talks concluded in Abu Dhabi.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/zelensky-warns-europe-over-us-russia-talks-on-broader-security-arrangements), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89954) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders at the European Political Community Summit in Dublin about US-Russia talks on security arrangements.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-russia-s-vladimir-putin-suggests-no-ukraine-compromise-in-meeting-with-us-envoys) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin indicated that the Kremlin would not compromise on its hardline demands to end the war in Ukraine during a meeting with US envoys.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/12/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-after-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-following-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/article71694418.ece) reported that during talks with US envoys, Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Russia will target foreign troops in Ukraine and ruled out agreeing to foreign troops being stationed there.

On 13 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261113-live-zelensky-and-kushner-confirm-that-europe-will-join-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-talks), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckn80j9jv3jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/europe/russia-ukraine-witkoff-kushner.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed European leaders will join the next round of peace talks.

On 12 Nov 2026, [RIA Novosti](https://ria.ru/20261112/putin-2131135070.html), [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/12/putin-predlozhil-organizovat-gumanitarnuiu-missiiu-iz-konstantinovki-i-nazval-gosgranitsu-edinstvennoi-liniei-razgranicheniia-s-ukrainoi-news) reported that Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian mission from Kostiantynivka during his meeting in the Kremlin.
On 12 Nov 2026, [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216967) reported that senior diplomat Sergey Ryabkov stated Russia clearly laid out its position at the Abu Dhabi talks and expects a response.

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/13/mundo/028n1mun?partner=rss) reported that the Israeli army attacked Nasser hospital for the seventh time, killing at least seven Palestinians.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-hamas-says-board-of-peace-adopts-misleading-israeli-narrative-on-gaza-hospitals/) reported that Hamas strongly rejected the Board of Peace's adoption of what it called a misleading Israeli narrative regarding the use of Gaza hospitals for military command.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202897/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%81%D9%89-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported that the Peace Council in Gaza stated that the human casualties from the Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Khan Younis confirm the need to implement Trump's peace plan immediately.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190087/%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%88%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A1%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88) reported that the 'Himaya' human rights center condemned the targeting of the surgical department at Nasser Medical Complex as a war crime.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/12/israeli-airstrike-nasser-hospital-gaza-kills-surgeon) reported that an Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza killed a surgeon and five others, including patients awaiting surgery.

On 12 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-targets-senior-hamas-member-in-gaza-hospital-strike/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/israel-afirma-que-objetivo-bombardeo-hospital-era-comandante-hamas_202611126af597d74196933d7eda7a4c.html) reported that Israel stated the target of its strike on a hospital was a Hamas commander named Muhamad abu Ismail.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190073/%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1) reported that Hamas political bureau member Basem Naim held Israel and the Peace Council responsible for targeting the Nasser Medical Complex.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190058/%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-) reported that Palestinian factions condemned the Israeli bombing of the surgical building at Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Yunis.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190015/%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%82%D9%88%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that 398 Israeli settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque courtyards and performed Talmudic rituals.

reports.text: On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

On 12 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

On 12 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

On 11 Nov 2026, [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

On 11 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
On 11 Nov 2026, [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

On 11 Nov 2026, [De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

stories.title: Indonesia: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resignation and Political Turmoil

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

On 12 Nov 2026, [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

On 12 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

On 12 Nov 2026, [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

On 12 Nov 2026, [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

On 12 Nov 2026, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

On 12 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

On 11 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

On 11 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441607/palace-respects-parliament-inquiry-push-into-vps-diploma) reported that the Indonesian Presidential Palace stated it respects the parliamentary political process concerning an inquiry into the Vice President's diploma.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

On 10 Nov 2026, [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

On 10 Nov 2026, [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

stories.title: South Africa's ANC backs Ramaphosa despite local election losses
stories.label: South Africa: ANC Suffers Historic Setback in Municipal Elections

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130034.html) reported that the MK party, EFF, and SACP formed a bloc called the Council of the Left representing 20 percent of the municipal vote, with conditional support for the ANC.

On 13 Nov 2026, [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/after-suffering-its-worst-election-result-what-s-next-for-the-anc-and-for-south-africa/a-79929902?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a crushing local election result across South Africa left the ruling ANC searching for answers regarding public frustration.

On 13 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/south-africas-anc-backs-ramaphosa-despite-local-election-losses/) reported that leaders of the African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after suffering a defeat at the ballot box.

On 12 Nov 2026, [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611120239.html) reported that about 138 municipalities in South Africa have no political party with enough seats to govern alone, forcing parties to negotiate agreements to share power.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/south-african-olympic-swimmer-switches-allegiance-to-the-netherlands/) reported that South African Olympic swimmer Tatjana Smith switched her allegiance to the Netherlands due to financial and practical challenges.

On 9 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-10-from-475-to-325-the-ancs-local-government-slide-in-one-chart/) reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Star (South Africa)](https://iol.co.za/the-star/news/2026-11-10-seven-new-parties-set-to-shake-up-cape-town-council-after-local-government-elections/) reported that newly elected municipal councils have 14 days to hold their first meetings and elect political leaders, while 127 hung councils face coalition negotiations.

On 10 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took 30.76 percent of votes in municipal elections, marking its worst-ever result.

On 9 Nov 2026, [France 24 Africa](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/eye-on-africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-suffers-a-historic-setback-in-local-elections-as-coalition-talks-begin) reported that South Africa's ruling ANC party secured just 30 percent of the vote in local elections, marking its worst-ever result as coalition talks began.

On 7 Nov 2026, according to [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/south-africa/2026-11-08-iec-declares-2026-local-elections-free-and-fair-as-sa-enters-coalition-era/), the Electoral Commission of South Africa declared the 2026 local elections free and fair while ordering recounts in five wards.

stories.title: Paraguay political and banking crisis

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

On 13 Nov 2026, [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

On 12 Nov 2026, [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

On 12 Nov 2026, [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

On 10 Nov 2026, [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

reports.text: On 13 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup-through-knesset-committees/000001a1-d12f-da30-a7fb-d9bf1ba40000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc seeks to control key Knesset committees to undo Netanyahu's judicial coup.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

On 12 Nov 2026, [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177688) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz responded to Eisenkot by stating that Tel Aviv does not need the opposition's approval to continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

On 11 Nov 2026, [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-leaders-were-unaware-of-yashars-planned-talks-with-likud/000001a1-ca01-d1f4-a7f9-cac3d5240000) reported that Lieberman, Bennett and Golan learned of the planned Yashar-Likud talks only after they were canceled following Netanyahu's speech attacking Arab parties.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

On 10 Nov 2026, [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

On 11 Nov 2026, [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/unfit-to-remain-in-office-eisenkot-attacks-netanyahu-after-hateful-knesset-speech/articleshow/135722286.cms) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after a hateful Knesset speech.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

On 10 Nov 2026, [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

On 10 Nov 2026, [HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/israels-new-knesset-sworn-in-as-eisenkot-seeks-to-form-government/000001a1-c600-d0f7-adfb-f721e5770000) reported that Israel's new Knesset was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot seeks to form a government, while President Herzog urged lawmakers to compromise.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/who-matan-kahana-israels-proposed-new-knesset-speaker) reported that anti-Netanyahu bloc leaders agreed to nominate Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/arab-party-to-back-eisenkot-blocs-bid-to-replace-knesset-speaker/000001a1-c553-dba2-a9f9-d57fa5ce0000) reported that Arab-led Joint List lawmaker Ahmad Tibi said his party would back the Eisenkot bloc's Knesset speaker nominee.

On 10 Nov 2026, [New York Times World](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/israel-parliament-eisenkot.html) reported that dozens of first-time lawmakers headed to the Knesset, where the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot has a majority.

On 10 Nov 2026, [BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crd939lpzjp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, had the first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/gadi-eisenkot-netanyahu-allies-form-israel-government) reported that former military chief Gadi Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu allies as he strived to form a government.

On 10 Nov 2026, [The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/israel-president-gadi-eisenkot-form-government) reported that Israel's president chose Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a government after the Knesset had been deadlocked.

On 10 Nov 2026, [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043517/new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-gadi-eisenkot-seeks-government) reported that Israel's new parliament was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses his majority.

On 9 Nov 2026, according to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.

On 9 Nov 2026, The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government ([Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323654-herzog-tells-eisenkot-to-continue-negotiations-with-lebanon)).

On 9 Nov 2026, Middle East Monitor reported that members of Israel's Shas party are considering supporting an Eisenkot-led government if United Torah Judaism joins ([Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-shas-reportedly-open-to-supporting-eizenkot-led-government-if-united-torah-judaism-joins/)).
